items.title: Breaking: RBA lifts interest rates by 0.25pc as inflation rises
items.description: RBA lifts interest rates by 0.25 per cent, to 3.85 per cent, after inflation rose "materially" in second half of 2025.

items.title: Three Nationals banned from reunited Coalition cabinet until July under Ley's offer
items.description: Sussan Ley has given David Littleproud a list of non-negotiable conditions, which if accepted could see the Coalition reunited before the end of the week.

items.title: Live: Nationals sit on crossbench as PM grilled on cost of living
items.description: The Nationals have taken their seats on the crossbench in Question Time in the House of Representatives as the prime minister is grilled on the cost of living. Follow live.

items.title: NSW protest restrictions extended ahead of Israel president's visit
items.description: The NSW Police commissioner announces restrictions on protests will be extended, ahead of planned demonstrations against the upcoming Sydney visit of Israel's president.

items.title: One Nation 'spot the Westerner' video condemned
items.description: A One Nation party official has filmed strangers on Melbourne's streets claiming the city "doesn't look like a Western nation at all".

items.title: What the newly released Epstein files say about Donald Trump
items.description: Donald Trump's name appears many times in the Epstein files — including on an FBI list of men who are named as subjects of "salacious information". So what have we learned about the US president?

items.title: Gold crashes after 'running on disaster scenario' that is yet to play out
items.description: The precious metals market collapses following the appointment of new US Federal Reserve chair Kevin Warsh, and some analysts say it signals a significant shift in the world's financial markets.

items.title: Details of NDIS alternative for some autistic children finally revealed
items.description: The federal government has released the model for its Thriving Kids program, aimed at setting up services and supports run by states and territories outside the NDIS.

items.title: 'Beautiful' young Australian mourned as Japanese police investigate ski lift death
items.description: Queensland woman Brooke Day, 22, is being remembered as a "cherished teammate" following her death at a popular Japanese ski resort.

items.title: Parents say daughter's suicidal thoughts were downplayed and dismissed
items.description: A hospital has apologised to the parents of 19-year-old Amber Wraith, who took her own life in 2022. Her family hopes her death will prompt changes in the way mental health patients are treated.

items.title: 'Incredible' act by critically endangered bat pictured for first time
items.description: Often compared to a "teddy bear", advocates hope the special snap of an endangered flying fox carrying its pup will shine a light on the Christmas Island animal.

items.title: Police to conduct more firearms testing as part of Dezi Freeman search
items.description: Victoria Police is continuing to search bushland in the Mount Buffalo National Park for traces of alleged gunman Dezi Freeman.

items.title: Teachers face sack for hate speech in NSW classrooms, premier says
items.description: Teachers or school staff found to have breached bolstered NSW hate speech laws face tough sanctions, including the possibility of being fired.

items.title: Victorian opposition vows to block health promotion agency's axing
items.description: The Allan Government's plan to merge VicHealth with the health department hits a major political roadblock, with the state opposition vowing to vote against the move.

items.title: 'Scary is good': Why Fifita will lean on Bennett to rebuild NRL career
items.description: After a season lost to injury, newly minted South Sydney backrower David Fifita will lean on Rabbitohs coach Wayne Bennett in an effort to reclaim his status as one of the NRL's most dangerous players.

items.title: Debut novel offers a frank depiction of reality as a high school teacher
items.description: Sita Walker, an English teacher from Brisbane, explains how she tackled her first work of fiction, set in a single hour at a state high school.

items.title: US Today show host's mother is missing in Arizona and authorities suspect an abduction
items.description: Police have declared a crime scene after the mother of US TV personality Savannah Guthrie went missing from her home. Here's what we know.

items.title: Woman sues former teacher, state over alleged rape as student
items.description: A woman is suing a former accounting teacher at the then-Hobart Matriculation College, alleging he raped her when she was a 16-year-old student in the 1980s and offered her cash to terminate a pregnancy.

items.title: Boy swims four hours to shore to save family swept out to sea
items.description: A 13-year-old boy has been hailed a hero after swimming four hours through rough seas to get help for his mother and two siblings, who were swept out to sea on an inflatable paddleboard in WA's South West.

items.title: Gympie 'woodchipper killer' to serve life sentence after appeal rejected
items.description: In 2022 Gregory Lee Roser was found guilty of murder after beating a man with a metal bar and then placing his body in a woodchipper.

items.title: Affordable homes absent from Queensland's new housing policy
items.description: There are no mandates for social or affordable homes in the Queensland state government's latest action to address the housing crisis.

items.title: Class action alleges contamination by one of world's biggest goldmines
items.description: Landowners in central west NSW are behind an environmental class action against one of the world's biggest goldmines, alleging contamination of more than 2,000 properties.

items.title: Deep Creek bushfire rips through 1,600 hectares
items.description: A bushfire on South Australia's Fleurieu Peninsula has had its warning level again downgraded, but the Country Fire Service says it has burned more than 1,600 hectares and remains uncontrolled.

items.title: 'Massive, bright' light seen in Victorian skies — but it's not a meteor
items.description: Keen observers reported a "massive, bright orange meteor" streaking across the sky, but one astronomer says it was likely to be space debris from a Starlink satellite.

items.title: One Nation SA candidate Cory Bernardi says party will be 'strongest voice of opposition'
items.description: One Nation's lead candidate for South Australia Cory Bernardi has taken aim at the "two-party duopoly" in the state, with Pauline Hanson issuing a warning to Labor that her party would be "coming for your seats".
